source.name: Community Berger 6 mm 108 Grain BT Target

loads.notes: Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: Will o; Posted: Jun 14, 2023; Velocity_fps: 2880ish; 108 bt Berger. He wrote my br. The thread is 6br. Long drop tube. No pressure signs.

Community-reported anecdotal load, not a published manufacturer load; Author: spudgun; Posted: Mar 4, 2026; 108 Berger target. He wrote 108 Bergers on Mar 4 and 108 Berger target on May 8 for this ladder. The catalog 108 gr target bullet is the BT Target. .001 off the lands, which is not COAL. He did not restate the cartridge; the thread is 6mm BR. The 28 in barrel is from the May 8 post.
